messages:
Rowan - Partnerships: SI partner hit a bad runtime mismatch when onboarding with ROCm 5.9 + our container. They reported symbol lookup errors and segfaults during model load. Theyre asking for a firm recommendation before the co-marketing announcement. Ticket: https://redwood-internal/partners/SI-777 :thinking:
Priya - Eng Infra: Can you attach their container config and exact rocm packages? We need the stack to reproduce (kernel, ROCm, MIOpen, driver).
Rowan - Partnerships: Uploaded to the partner ticket: rocm-5.9, amdgpu 6.5, miopen 3.11, docker image sha256:abc123. They say 5.8 worked previously.
Omar - Runtime: Quick summary from my repro: rocm 5.9 pulls a newer miopen/rocblas that changes symbol versions. On model import we saw: "undefined symbol: rocblas_something_v2" then segfault. Repro steps: run container + python -c "import torch; model.load_state_dict(...)" on MI250.
Becky - Marketplace: We were about to rotate marketplace images to ROCm 5.9 to match partner perf notes. Given this, propose: 1) mark marketplace/stable as 5.8, 2) create marketplace/rocm-5.9-beta with a warning and opt-in.
Priya - Eng Infra: Agreed with Becky. Infra will run a matrix across kernel/amdgpu/rocm combinations. If 5.9 is a pure packaging mismatch we can either rebuild containers against 5.9 or pin for customers.
InfraBot: canary job created: RC-321 / mi250-repro / started. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/test/RC-321
Omar - Runtime: For runtime: add a symbol-compat check to our model-loader smoke: verify rocblas/miopen symbols at import time and fail-fast with actionable message. I'll add it to nightly.
Rowan - Partnerships: For partner comms I'd like a short clear line: "Were pausing broad ROCm 5.9 rollout while we validate library compatibility; SI partners can use our 5.8 stable images. We will provide a beta image for testing on request." I'll draft and share.
Becky - Marketplace: Action items: hold rotation to 5.9 (ETA 20m), add a beta channel doc, and add an opt-in flag for partner SI images. Ill also put a small banner on the onboarding page.
Priya - Eng Infra: If infra reproduces, next step is vendor escalation with ROCm packaging team. Contact: rocm-bugs@vendor.example.com. We'll attach kernel logs, dmesg, and container ldd outputs.
Omar - Runtime: Suggested acceptance for a 5.9 promotion: 1) no symbol errors on common stacks, 2) model-load pass across our top 10 models, 3) no regressions on memory/cold-start.
Rowan - Partnerships: Decision: hold public announcement until infra posts green or a clear rollback plan is in place. We can run a private demo with partner on pinned 5.8.
InfraBot: RC-321 finished: MI250 with ROCm 5.9 = FAIL (symbol lookup), ROCm 5.8 = PASS. Logs: https://ci.redwood/test/RC-321/logs
Priya - Eng Infra: Confirmed. Opening internal bug BR-834 and escalating to vendor with CI artifacts.
Becky - Marketplace: Hold applied: marketplace/stable -> ROCm 5.8. Creating marketplace/beta-rocm-5.9 and adding warnings for experimental use.
Omar - Runtime: I'll push the symbol-compat smoke and a diagnostic script partners can run that prints linked libraries and known-bad symbols. Snippet to share:
```
python - <<EOF
import ctypes, subprocess
print(subprocess.check_output(['ldd','/opt/rocm/lib/libmiopen.so']))
EOF
```
Rowan - Partnerships: Great. I'll notify SI PMs and legal about delaying the joint announcement and offer the partner a private run on the pinned image tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
Becky - Marketplace: Will keep the marketplace hold until infra posts green and vendor confirms. Posting update to the partner channel now. :lock:
